issue_context.title: [REGRESSION]: Label is not visible anymore
issue_context.body:
**Context:**
- GOOD Playwright Version: 1.8.1
- BAD Playwright Version: 1.9.1
- Operating System: Mac 11.1 & Ubuntu Bionic

**Code Snippet**

Playwright 1.9.1 says element is not visible but Playwright 1.8.1 works.

```javascript
const {chromium} = require('playwright');

(async () => {
  const browser = await chromium.launch();
  const page = await browser.newPage();
  await page.goto('https://v2.grommet.io/checkbox', { waitUntil: "domcontentloaded" });
  await page.click("label");
  await browser.close();
})();
```

review_comments: This inconsistency between isVisible and isEnabled is somewhat confusing. I'd at least expect them to check the same element (but I understand that it comes with another issues like you wouldn't be able to check if input is fillable).
